correctness.rationale: Proof reconstructs endomorphisms as affine from a second-difference recurrence; gives an if-and-only-if commutation equation. With u_i=a_i-1 and h=min v_p(u_i), a primitive coordinate forces the translation vector to be one scalar multiple modulo p^(e-h), giving exactly p^(e+(t-1)h) translation tuples. A nonunit multiplier makes h=0. The all-unit correction is recovered from an independently derived valuation-shell total T. Images and the product image have valuations nu_i and min(e,sum nu_i), yielding each coefficient for all p,e,t>=1. Both standalone checkers pass direct finite enumeration; this is supporting, not infinite proof.

value.rationale: The exact image-cardinality and composition-image joint census is a natural complete invariant of commuting endomorphism tuples, unbounded in quandle order and tuple length. It identifies the sharp boundary between singular-coordinate profiles, where fibers completely decouple and no rank correlations remain beyond the product valuation, and the all-bijective locus carrying all extra commutation weight. It supplies every joint coefficient, not just a scalar pair total or a limited numerical example; this matters for compositional collapse of simultaneously compatible quandle maps.
